examples.japanese: {半時間|はんじかん}{後|ご}に{会|あ}いましょう。
examples.english: Let's meet in half an hour.

examples.japanese: {歩|ある}いて{半時間|はんじかん}ぐらいです。
examples.english: It's about half an hour on foot.

examples.japanese: {半時間|はんじかん}{待|ま}っても{来|き}ませんでした。
examples.english: They didn't come even after waiting half an hour.

notes: {半時間|はんじかん} means 'half an hour' (30 minutes). Alternatively, {三十|さんじゅっ}{分|ぷん} (30 minutes) can be used. For telling time, 'half past' is expressed as {〜時|じ}{半|はん}: {三時|さんじ}{半|はん} (3:30). {半|はん} by itself means 'half.'
